prompt:

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:

- the box in the top row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a stairwell in a stone floor seen from above at an angle: grey stone steps leading down and away into darkness, with a low carved stone rail on the left, right and far side; it fills the box.
- the box in the middle row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (96x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a long wooden banquet table seen from the front in three-quarter view, with a white tablecloth, two candlesticks, plates, goblets and a roast, as wide as the box.
- the box in the middle row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a large carved stone fireplace standing against a wall, seen from the front, with a burning log fire glowing orange and a mantel with two candles; it fills the box.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a hanging wall tapestry with a deep blue background, a golden lion and a gold border.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, second position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a polished dark wooden writing desk with an open book, a quill and a candle.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
